upaṭṭhapeti.p: [Upa+ṭhā+ṇāpe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 [Upa+thapa+ṇe+ti. Dhātvattha. Paṭṭha-petīti nānāppakārena ṭhapesi. Maṇimañjū, 2. 365] (A) He places. He causes to stay near. He causes. He causes to look forward to. He causes to take care of and serve. (B) He takes care of and serves.

ဥပ+ထပ+ဏေ+တိ။ ဓာတွတ္ထ။ ပဋ္ဌ-ပေတီတိ နာနာပ္ပကာရေန ဌပေသိ။ မဏိမဉ္ဇူ၊ ၂။ ၃၆၅] (က)ထား၏၊ အနီး၌တည် ရှိစေ၏၊ ဖြစ်စေ၏၊ ရှေ့ရှုဖြစ်စေ၏၊ လုပ်ကျွေးပြုပြုစုစေ၏။(ခ)လုပ်ကွေးပြုစု၏။

ပါနီယံ ပရိဘောဇနီယံ ဥပဋ္ဌာပေတိ၊ သောက်ရေသုံးရေကို တည်ထား၏။ အတ္တဘာဝေ ခယဝယံ ဥပဋ္ဌာပေမ၊ ကိုယ်၏အဖြစ်၌ ကုန်ခြင်းပျက်ခြင်းကို အသင့်နှလုံးထားကုန်အံ့။ သတိံ ဥပဋ္ဌာပေတွာ၊ သတိကို ရှေးရှုထင်စေ၍။

upaṭṭhāpeti caus. 3 sg. of upatiṭṭhati qv .
CPD: upa-ṭṭh [ ā/a ] peti , pr. 3 sg. [ sa. upasthāpayati; caus. of upaṭṭhahati, upaṭṭhāti], 1. to make a person ( acc. ) to wait on, serve ( acc. or gen. ) ; 2. to procure, produce, fetch, bring, get ready; to supply, provide a person ( gen. ) with ( acc ); 3. of mental qualities or faculties (sati, dhiti, citta etc. ) : "to make present": to set up, summon up, get ready, exercise, cultivate; — forms: pr. ~eti etc.; part. ~enta-, gen. m. ~ayato; imper. ~ehi, ~etha; pot. ~eyya, ~eyyuṃ, 1 sg. ~e; aor. ~esi, ~esuṃ, 2 pl. ~ittha; abs. ~etvā, ~etvāna; inf. ~etuṃ; ger. ~etabba-; pp. ~ita q. v.; — 1. (na) sāmaṇero ~etabbo, Vin l 62, 25 ; 64, 5 ; na ekena dve sāmaṇerā ~etabbā . . . anujānāmi . . . ~āpetuṃ, 83, 23 foll.; bhikkhuniyo dāsaṃ ~enti, dāsiṃ ~enti + , ll 267, 10 foll.; bhikkhū ... Kaṇḍakaṃ ~enti, lV 307, 6 (tena attano upaṭṭhānaṃ kārāpeyya, Sp 871, 8 ad 307, 33 ~eyya); rājā . . . kumārassa dhātiyo ~esi, D ll 19, 24 ; pariṇāyaka-ratanaṃ . . . paṭibalo rājānaṃ cakkavaṭṭiṃ ~etabbam ~etuṃ, apayāpe- tabbaṃ apayāpetuṃ . . . ( proficient in causing the king to appoint him who is fit to be appointed, to dis- miss . . . ), M lll 176, 2 ; upaṭṭhātuṃ vā ~etuṃ vā, A V 72, 21 ; — 2. sace pāniyaṃ (pari-bhojaniyaṃ) na hoti, pāniyaṃ (paribh.) ~etabbaṃ, Vin ll 210, 5, 6 = lV 307, 4 , " cf. Mil 366, 17 ; Sv 270, 2 ; bhagavato pāni- yaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ ~eti, Ud 42, 5 ( so read with C e S e and Ud-a 251, 3 for E e paṭṭhāpeti); ekacce pādo- dakaṃ ~esuṃ, M l 171, 30 ; pariveṇaṃ sammajjitvā udaka-dantapoṇaṃ ~esi, Sp 41, 2 ; mukhodakaṃ dan- tapoṇaṃ ~esi, Mil 15, 7 ; — nāvaṃ ~etvā vohāraṃ karissāmi, Ja lV 2, 14 ; tassa mittâmaccā . . . bhisak- kaṃ salla-kattaṃ ~eyyuṃ, M l 429, 4 = 506, 9 ; sūlâvutaṃ mocayi . . . tikicchakānañ ca ~esi ( "and handed him to the healers" ), Pv 577; rājā Vipassissa kumārassa . . . pañca kāma-guṇāni ~esi, D ll 21, 8 ; taṃ purisaṃ . . . pañca kāma-guṇāni ~etha, 325, 3 ; — 3. sati, Ānanda, ~etabbā, D ll 141, 17 ; yāvakīvañ ca bhikkhū paccattaṃ yeva satiṃ ~essanti . . . , 77, 19 ; satiṃ, ayyaputta, ~ehi, mā vippalapi, S lV 303, 1 ; satiṃ ~etvāna "summoning up mindfulness", Th 946, Thī 182; sa.pīti paṭividitā hoti ... satiṃ ~ayato, Paṭis l 187, 15 ; chasu dvāresu ( six senses ) . . . sati-dovārikaṃ tattha ~eyya paṇḍito, Saddh 356; — ( roused from sleep ) rājā satiṃ ~etvā "ko eso" ti pucchi ( "having recovered his senses" ) ; in frequent cliche . . . ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ ~etvā, e. g. Vin l 24, 35 ; D l 71, 19 ; M l 219, 31 ; S l 170, 16 ; A l 182, 14 = 183, 16 = 184, 16 ; Vibh 252, 11 (Sp 408, 7-11 = Sv 210, 28 — 211, 5 etc. ) ; — bhīto pabujjhitvā . . . sayanā vuṭṭhāya dhitiṃ ~etvā ( "summoning up his courage" ), Ja l 266, 23 ; tibbaṃ chandañ ca pemañ ca tasmiṃ disvā ~ape, Mil 397, 18*; cittaṃ ~etvāna ekaggaṃ susamāhitaṃ, Thī 177; upajjhāyo saddhivihārikamhi putta-cittaṃ ~essati ( "will call up towards the s. a son-mind", se. will develop a disposition as towards a son ), saddhivi- hāriko upajjhāyamhi pitu-cittam ~essati, Vin l 45, 27; bhikkhave, mātu-mattīsu mātu-cittaṃ (bhaginī- mattīsu bhaginī-cittaṃ, dhītu-mattīsu dhītu-cittaṃ) ~etha, S lV 110, 31 ; sa-brahmacānsu metta-cittaṃ ~ehi, Vin ll 249, 4 ; tassa (satthuno) te sāvakā (na) . . . aññā-cittaṃ ~enti, D l 230, 13 ; 231, 1 ; M ll 254, 21 etc. ( cf. aññā-citta CPD l); vimokhesu pihaṃ ~eti, . . .~ayato ..., M lll 218, 27, 30 = 219, 2, 5 ; kati dhamme (pañca dh.) ~etvā paro codetabbo, Vin ll 249, 30-36 = D lll 236, 33 — 237, 4 ; — further ref. see PTC; — [aruṇaṃ ~ento Spk l 25, 6 read with B e uṭṭhapento].
